scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 11-UNIT MAShQLAR (55-bet, PDF 54). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '11'.

CHAP USTUN:
3) 'Rob Cruise is shipwrecked on a deserted island. Look at the prompts and expand them to write Type 2 Conditional sentences, as in the example.' RASM: orolda palma ostida yirtiq kiyimli erkak (Rob Cruise), atrofida pufakchalar: 1 have/axe/cut down tree/build/hut 2 have matches/make a fire 3 have/radio/call for help 4 have/boat/get off/island 5 there be/stream/drink fresh water 6 have/fishing rod/catch fish 7 have scissors/cut my hair 8 have/razor/shave my beard. 1 If I had an axe, I would cut down a tree and build a hut. 2-8 ......
4) 'Look at the pictures and the prompts and ask and answer questions, as in the example.' SURATLAR: 1 radio va stereo - buy/radio/stereo. A: Shall I buy a radio? B: If I were you, I'd buy a stereo. 2 gamburger va olma - eat/hamburger/apple 3 Britaniya va Kanada bayroqlari - visit/UK/Canada 4 videokasseta va kino lentasi - rent/video/go to/cinema 5 qizil va sariq lolalar - send her/red tulips/yellow tulips

O'NG USTUN:
5) 'Complete the sentences below about yourself.' 1 If I studied harder, ...... 2 If I went to the supermarket, ...... 3 If I was older, ...... 4 If I was ill, ...... 5 If I lived near the sea, ...... 6 If I visited my parents, ...... 7 If I spoke Spanish fluently, ...... 8 If my favourite football team won the championship, ......

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '55'.

exercises.instructionEn: Rob Cruise is shipwrecked on a deserted island. Look at the prompts and expand them to write Type 2 Conditional sentences, as in the example. 1 have/axe/cut down tree/build/hut → If I had an axe, I would cut down a tree and build a hut. 2 have matches/make a fire 3 have/radio/call for help 4 have/boat/get off/island 5 there be/stream/drink fresh water 6 have/fishing rod/catch fish 7 have scissors/cut my hair 8 have/razor/shave my beard
exercises.instructionUz: Rob Kruz kema halokatidan keyin kimsasiz orolda qolgan. Ko'rsatmalarga qarang va 2-tur shart gaplar yozing, namunadagidek. 1 have/axe/cut down tree/build/hut → Boltam bo'lganda, daraxt kesib kulba qurardim. 2 have matches/make a fire 3 have/radio/call for help 4 have/boat/get off/island 5 there be/stream/drink fresh water 6 have/fishing rod/catch fish 7 have scissors/cut my hair 8 have/razor/shave my beard
exercises.explanationUz:
ROB KRUZ - OROLDA (Robinzon
  Kruzo kabi).

  If I HAD ..., I WOULD ...
  (aslida yo'q - xayol)

  5 If there WERE a stream, I
    would drink fresh water.
    ('there be' → there were/was)


⚠ 'SHIPWRECKED':

  = kema halokatiga uchragan.


⚠ 'A DESERTED ISLAND':

  = kimsasiz orol.


⚠ 'A HUT':

  = kulba.


⚠ 'A RAZOR':

  = ustara.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 If I had an axe, I would cut down a tree and build a hut.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Boltam bo'lganda, daraxt kesib kulba qurardim.
modelAnswers: 1 If I had an axe, I would cut down a tree and build a hut.
2 If I had matches, I would make a fire.
3 If I had a radio, I would call for help.
4 If I had a boat, I would get off the island.
5 If there were a stream, I would drink fresh water.
6 If I had a fishing rod, I would catch fish.
7 If I had scissors, I would cut my hair.
8 If I had a razor, I would shave my beard.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Boltam bo'lganda, daraxt kesib kulba qurardim. (NAMUNA)
2 Gugurtim bo'lganda, olov yoqardim.
3 Radiom bo'lganda, yordam chaqirardim.
4 Qayig'im bo'lganda, oroldan ketardim.
5 Daryocha bo'lganda, toza suv ichardim. (there were)
6 Qarmog'im bo'lganda, baliq tutardim.
7 Qaychim bo'lganda, sochimni qirqardim.
8 Ustaram bo'lganda, soqolimni olardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prompts and ask and answer questions, as in the example. 1 buy/radio/stereo → A: Shall I buy a radio? B: If I were you, I'd buy a stereo. 2 eat/hamburger/apple 3 visit/UK/Canada 4 rent/video/go to/cinema 5 send her/red tulips/yellow tulips
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlar va ko'rsatmalarga qarang va savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. 1 buy/radio/stereo → A: Radio sotib olaymi? B: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, stereo sotib olardim. 2 eat/hamburger/apple 3 visit/UK/Canada 4 rent/video/go to/cinema 5 send her/red tulips/yellow tulips
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT - IF I WERE YOU, I'D ...

  A: Shall I + 1-variant?
  B: If I were you, I'd + 2-
     variant.

  ⚠ 4-band: 'rent a video' → 'go
  to the cinema' (fe'l
  o'zgaradi).


⚠ 'SHALL I ...?':

  = ... qilaymi? (maslahat
  so'rash).


⚠ 'TO RENT A VIDEO':

  = video ijaraga olmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: Shall I buy a radio? B: If I were you, I'd buy a stereo.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Radio sotib olaymi? B: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, stereo sotib olardim.
modelAnswers: 1 A: Shall I buy a radio? B: If I were you, I'd buy a stereo.
2 A: Shall I eat a hamburger? B: If I were you, I'd eat an apple.
3 A: Shall I visit the UK? B: If I were you, I'd visit Canada.
4 A: Shall I rent a video? B: If I were you, I'd go to the cinema.
5 A: Shall I send her red tulips? B: If I were you, I'd send her yellow tulips.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Radio sotib olaymi? - Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, stereo sotib olardim. (NAMUNA)
2 Gamburger yeyaymi? - Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, olma yerdim.
3 Buyuk Britaniyaga boraymi? - Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, Kanadaga borardim.
4 Video ijaraga olaymi? - Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, kinoga borardim.
5 Unga qizil lola yuboraymi? - Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, sariq lola yuborardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences below about yourself. 1 If I studied harder, ... 2 If I went to the supermarket, ... 3 If I was older, ... 4 If I was ill, ... 5 If I lived near the sea, ... 6 If I visited my parents, ... 7 If I spoke Spanish fluently, ... 8 If my favourite football team won the championship, ...
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'zingiz haqingizda to'ldiring. 1 Qattiqroq o'qiganimda, ... 2 Supermarketga borganimda, ... 3 Kattaroq bo'lganimda, ... 4 Kasal bo'lganimda, ... 5 Dengiz yaqinida yashaganimda, ... 6 Ota-onamni ziyorat qilganimda, ... 7 Ispanchada ravon gapirganimda, ... 8 Sevimli futbol jamoam chempionatda yutganda, ...
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZIM HAQIMDA - BOSh GAPNI
  TUGATISh.

  If qismi berilgan (past simple)
  → siz WOULD + fe'l bilan
  tugating.

  ⚠ 'If I was older' - og'zaki
  (rasmiy: were).
exercises.exampleEn: If I studied harder, I would get better marks.
modelAnswers: 1 If I studied harder, I would get better marks.
2 If I went to the supermarket, I would buy some fruit.
3 If I was older, I would drive a car.
4 If I was ill, I would stay in bed.
5 If I lived near the sea, I would swim every day.
6 If I visited my parents, I would help them in the garden.
7 If I spoke Spanish fluently, I would travel to Spain.
8 If my favourite football team won the championship, I would be very happy.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Qattiqroq o'qiganimda, yaxshiroq baho olardim.
2 Supermarketga borganimda, meva sotib olardim.
3 Kattaroq bo'lganimda, mashina haydardim.
4 Kasal bo'lganimda, yotoqda yotardim.
5 Dengiz yaqinida yashaganimda, har kuni suzardim.
6 Ota-onamni ziyorat qilganimda, ularga bog'da yordam berardim.
7 Ispanchada ravon gapirganimda, Ispaniyaga sayohat qilardim.
8 Sevimli futbol jamoam chempionatda yutganda, juda xursand bo'lardim.

patterns.formula: If I had + NARSA, I would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If I had matches, I would make a fire.

patterns.formula: Shall I + FE'L? — If I were you, I'd + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Shall I buy a radio? — If I were you, I'd buy a stereo.
patterns.exampleUz: Radio sotib olaymi? — Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, stereo olardim.

patterns.formula: If there were + NARSA, I would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If there were a stream, I would drink fresh water.
